sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:24

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:24:1
items.html:
The externality, etc. — the first Ibur was twelve months, and the second Ibur, of the Mochin, was nine months: For the Ibur of the externality is the discernment of the inclusion of the NHY in the HGT of AA, which is the secret of “three within three”; and these VAK must be included in the VAK of AVI, likewise in the inclusion of the NHY of AVI in the HGT of AVI; and twice VAK are twelve months. But for the Gadlut, which is the second Ibur — when his VAK are already complete, and they need only the inclusion of the VAK of ZA in the HGT of AVI, which are only nine discernments, namely, nine months.
And the first Ibur of the internality is likewise nine months, for the VAK of ZA are then included in the HGT of Atik, which are in the HBD of AA, which are nine discernments. And in the second Ibur, of the Mochin of the internality, the VAK of ZA are found in the discernment of the ZAT of Atik, when he receives from the seven corrections of the Galgalta of AA; therefore they are only seven discernments, namely, seven months. And there are yet many reasons, as will be written ahead.
However, we must understand the sources of the matter, according to what is explained above: the discernment of the internality of ZON is the secret of the correction of the four statures of the HGT of Nekudim up to the Chazeh. For now, in Atzilut, the HGT of Atik and the GAR of AA stand there, for the Peh of the Rosh of Atik clothes the place of the Peh of AVI of Nekudim, and his HGT are found in the place of the HGT of Nekudim exactly. You also know that the Rosh of AA clothes upon the HGT of Atik; thus the HGT of Atik and the GAR of AA took the place of the HGT of Nekudim. Therefore, at the time that ZA takes something of the NRNHY of the internality, which are the DHGT of Nekudim, it is necessary that he clothe and take from the HGT of Atik, which stand there now — but in the coupling of Katnut, before he attains the inner GAR, he takes only from the discernment of the HGT of Atik, before they clothe in the Rosh of AA, for then they bestow VAK without a Rosh. And in the second coupling, of the Gadlut, he also takes from the discernment of the Rosh of AA, that is, from the discernment of the HGT of Atik that have already become GAR and HBD in AA.
And in like manner you will also understand the two Iburim of the externality: for in the coupling of the Katnut of the externality he receives only from the HGT of AA, before they are turned and become HBD in AVI, when he receives only VAK, in the discernment of “three within three,” as above. But in the second coupling, of the Mochin of the Gadlut, he receives from the HGT of AVI, that is, from those HGT that return and become the discernment of HBD. Therefore he also attains this discernment, that his HGT become HBD, as is known. And with this you will understand all the distinctions between the NRNHY of the internality and the NRNHY of the externality.
